rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for gaining unauthorized access to a computer system, website, network, or account.

example.english: They used a program to hack into the company website and even changed the homepage.
example.traditional: 佢哋用程式入侵咗公司個網站，仲改埋首頁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jung6 cing4 sik1 jap6 cam1 zo2 gung1 si1 go3 mong5 zaam6 zung6 goi2 maai4 sau2 jip6

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose Cantonese noun for illegal access to a computer system.

example.english: The hack of our company server this morning meant we couldn't work all morning.
example.traditional: 今朝公司個伺服器俾人黑客入侵，成個上午都開唔到工。
example.jyutping: gam1 ziu1 gung1 si1 go3 si6 fuk6 hei3 bei2 jan4 haak1 haak3 jap6 cam1 sing4 go3 soeng6 ng5 dou1 hoi1 m4 dou3 gung1

rows.note: Use this for a practical tip or shortcut that makes everyday life easier.

example.english: This everyday hack makes garlic much easier to peel.
example.traditional: 呢個生活小貼士係將蒜頭放入暖水浸一陣，會容易剝好多。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sang1 wut6 siu2 tip1 si2 hai6 zoeng1 syun3 tau4 fong3 jap6 nyun5 seoi2 zam3 jat1 zan6 wui6 jung4 ji6 mok1 hou2 do1

rows.note: Use this specifically when someone cheats in a game with unauthorized software or modifications, rather than breaking into an account.

example.english: They hack in games by using an unauthorized add-on, so they win every time.
example.traditional: 佢打機成日用外掛，所以次次都贏。
example.jyutping: keoi5 daa2 gei1 seng4 jat6 jung6 ngoi6 gwaa3 so2 ji5 ci3 ci3 dou1 jeng4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a cough without phlegm.

example.english: I've had a dry cough lately; it has nothing to do with a hack.
example.traditional: 我呢排成日乾咳，唔關黑客入侵事。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ni1 paai4 seng4 jat6 gon1 kat1 m4 gwaan1 hak1 haak3 jap6 cam1 si6

rows.note: Use this for coughing; the noisy or persistent quality usually comes from the context.

example.english: They hack nonstop on the bus, and everyone stares at them.
example.traditional: 佢喺巴士度不停咳，成車人都望住佢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 baa1 si2 dou6 bat1 ting4 kat1 sing4 ce1 jan4 dou1 mong6 zyu6 keoi5
